acceptanceCriteria.text: No Mottainai job performs duplicate `pnpm install` because of the migration.
Integration, package/E2E, Runtime/Nix/VM and other product-specific jobs retain their existing proof semantics.
Shared pnpm provisioning runs successfully from the organization-owned `@main` authority.
Exact pnpm-version behavior and frozen-lockfile installation remain enforced.
Cache miss/eviction does not become a correctness failure.
The repository-local `.github/actions/setup-pnpm-node` is deleted if all consumers are migrated.
PR Actions prove all affected paths.
A current-main full Runtime CI run after merge proves no regression and records relevant setup/critical-path timings.

issue.title: ci: replace local pnpm setup with the shared organization action
